# unfurL Agent Builder

Curated by Skill Harbor — unfurL Agent Builder turns planning an AI agent into a Diablo-style character build. This free web app walks you through a gamified questionnaire (pick an archetype, describe your agent's purpose), then generates a personalized build plan: models, tools and skills presented as RPG gear, with rarity tiers, stats and a "why it fits this build" note on each pick. The item database ships inside the page and the creator says it is refreshed daily; a built-in GitHub search lets you add more items to your stash, and you can export or print the finished plan. Spotted in a comment by u/unfurL on r/AIAgentsInAction, built by the unfurl-repo GitHub account. No account, no install, no payment — just open the page (desktop and mobile versions).

Honest caveats: the repo has no license file, so reuse terms are unclear. The recommendations are one creator's curation baked into a ~30 MB page — they may be stale or miss newer options, and suggested models or tools may carry their own costs. Network-wise the page is quiet: it calls GitHub's API only when you use the item search, plus privacy-friendly GoatCounter analytics; the "message the dev" button emails the creator through a third-party form service. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
